title: Merit expands its presence in fragrance with second scent launch, New Wave
summary: The minimalist beauty brand is extending its fragrance offering with New Wave L’Extrait de Parfum, which claims to break ‘the traditional rules of perfumery’ by reimagining a classic Ambre 83 structure. It follows on from the success of Merit’s first fragrance launch, Retrospect
